description: Implementation of metrics handler for CU-CP, managing periodic and on-demand metrics reports, including session management and timer setup.

classes.name: metrics_report_session
classes.description: Interface for a metrics report session, allowing reconfiguration and stopping the session.

classes.name: periodic_metrics_report_session_impl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of metrics_report_session for periodic metrics reporting.

methods.name: create_periodic_report_session
methods.description: Creates a new periodic metrics report session and returns a handler object.

methods.name: request_metrics_report
methods.description: Generates and returns a current metrics report, possibly postponing if the task queue is full.

methods.name: create_report
methods.description: Assembles a metrics report by querying various handlers.

methods.name: create_periodic_session
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new periodic reporting session with timer setup.

methods.name: request_session_reconfiguration
methods.description: Reconfigures an existing session's reporting period.

methods.name: request_session_deletion
methods.description: Deletes a session and stops its timer.
